context:
Treat run identity as a contract shared by routing, comparison, receipts, and
labels. Add one helper boundary for result links and visible identity, then
wire the existing surfaces through it instead of adding component-local ID
formatting.
description:
The post-remediation review found that Results Explorer now has better
duplicate-name disambiguation, but it still leaks conflicting run identities
and removes receipt/detail reachability from high-use benchmark views.

Benchmark Matrix and Ranks views can show the runs a user wants to inspect,
but those rows no longer expose a result-detail or receipt affordance. Compare
selection trays also display compact compare IDs such as `d28345e6` while row
labels and result-detail routes show different public result IDs such as
`a62d0d72`. This makes the same run appear to have two identities.

This TODO defines a single public run-identity contract, separates URL
transport IDs from visible IDs, and restores compact detail/receipt reachability
in Matrix and Ranks without reintroducing tall frozen rows.

anti_patterns.dont: concatenate source/origin markers directly into platform names.
fix the mismatch by hiding all IDs from selected trays.
restore receipt reachability by reintroducing a wide frozen receipt column.
show `short_id` in one surface and `result_id` in another without a visible relationship between them.

preserves.behavior: Existing shareable compare URLs must continue to resolve for supported ID aliases.
Matrix and Ranks density improvements must not be undone by stacking receipt text, trust badges, version, and source in one cell.
Run identity disambiguation must remain concise in tables and complete in titles/aria labels.
Selection controls must remain keyboard reachable and screen-reader labelled.

work_units.notes:
Adopt an explicit contract for every result-bearing surface:
  - `result_id` is the canonical public result identity and result-detail
    route target;
  - `short_id` may be accepted as an input alias in compare URLs, but it
    must not be shown as the visible run identity unless it is clearly
    labelled as a URL token and paired with the public result ID;
  - compact spaces may show a stable public token derived from `result_id`,
    but the same token must appear in row labels, selected trays, detail
    links, chart titles, and receipt affordances;
  - platform name, version, run date, trust tier, source, and public ID are
    separate fields and must not be concatenated into an unparseable label.
Record the decision in the implementation PR description or a small
verification note. Decision gate: do not patch `compareIdForRow` or any
component until this contract is written down.
